newsitem.title: CHINA: France's Eridania in China corn project.
newsitem.headline: France's Eridania in China corn project.

text.p: Eridania Beghin-Say SA (EBS) of France and the Jifa Group of China's northeastern Jilin province have begun construction of a plant capable of processing 300,000 tonnes per year, company officials said on Monday.
Construction began in Songyuan in Jilin province on Friday, a Jifa Group official said.
The project will require investment of 1.425 billion yuan ($171.68 million) in its first phase and 500 million yuan in its second phase, the official said.
The French firm held a 51 percent share, he said.
The project, expected to be operational in 1999, will mainly produce starch, glucose and other products, he said.
